name: Brottö
description: Brottö is the shortest SAT section: a one-kilometer, easy gravel-road walk from Brottö brygga through a living small-scale archipelago farm landscape to the gate toward Ingmarsö. Present it as a cultural-reserve connector rather than a standalone service section: the walk is simple and unusually accessible, but it passes private working farm and grazing land with Highland cattle and has no confirmed toilet, water, food, waste or overnight facilities on Brottö itself.
utilities: No toilet, drinking water, waste, food, shop, campsite, shelter or overnight facility was confirmed on Brottö in iteration 1.
Brottö brygga has ferry access and likely a waiting shelter, but the waiting shelter is transit comfort only, not a hiking shelter or overnight/rest facility.
Nearest reliable services for food/water/toilet are on Ingmarsö, especially Södra Ingmarsö/guest harbor/Coop/krog/bakery, but these belong to the Ingmarsö section or nearby context.
The SAT section has information/map signs at the beginning and end and a small exhibition behind the quay-side sign.
waterSources: No reliable drinking-water source was found on the Brottö section in iteration 1.
Use Ingmarsö service points for water planning when chaining Brottö with Ingmarsö; carry water if relying on Brottö alone.
notes: Route shape: linear gravel-road connector from Brottö brygga through Brottö skärgårdsjordbruk cultural reserve to the Ingmarsö gate.
Brottö is not marked with SAT ribbons/arrows because the route is straightforward; use information/map signs at the quay and end.
The section is unusually accessible for SAT because it follows a short gravel road, but still use rural-ferry/farm-road caveats.
Do not let trail accessibility imply end-to-end accessible travel: Visit Roslagen says Brottö and Ingmarsö piers are not accessibility-adapted.
Stay on the road/trail through the working farm landscape and respect private land, gates, grazing animals and farm operations.
Scottish Highland cattle graze large parts of the cultural reserve; keep distance and keep dogs leashed/controlled, especially March-September and around livestock.
No toilet, waste bin, drinking water, shop, food, campsite, shelter or overnight possibility was confirmed on Brottö itself.
Take waste back to the mainland or appropriate service points; do not rely on island waste handling.
No fireplace/firepit was confirmed; do not plan to light fires on Brottö, never light fires on rock and check current fire bans.

Brottösand/Storsand old brickworks, clay-pit remains, shore meadows and Storkärret/Sandvreten heritage exist west of Brottö brygga; iteration 4 promoted this to an explicit optional off-route heritage POI, not part of the official 1 km SAT line.
Brottö brygga waiting shelter is transit comfort only if retained; do not expose it as a hiking shelter.
Use live Waxholmsbolaget/SL planning for Brottö because request stops, holiday changes, ticket validity and summer timetable gaps matter.
Services on Södra Ingmarsö are useful nearby/chaining context, not Brottö section facilities.

facilities.name: Brottö brygga
facilities.description: Waxholmsbolaget ferry quay and direct SAT Brottö start point. Timetable details belong in access metadata; check live planning for exact date and request-stop details.

facilities.name: Brottö skärgårdsjordbruk kulturreservat
facilities.description: Stockholm County's first cultural reserve, protecting a living small-scale archipelago farming landscape with old fields, meadows, stone walls, farm buildings and grazing Highland cattle. Pin at the quay-side information sign/small exhibition, which is the clearest visitor interpretation point; include farmyard/grazing, private-land, gate and cattle cautions here.

facilities.name: Södergärdet medieval field and stone wall
facilities.description: Near-route heritage candidate: Länsstyrelsen describes older field-system and stone-wall remains near the road toward Ingmarsö, north of Södergärdet. Coordinate is approximate; present as low-key cultural landscape context, not a standalone attraction with infrastructure.

facilities.name: Brottösand and Storsand heritage detour
facilities.description: Optional off-route westward detour from Brottö brygga along Storsandsvägen toward Brottösand/Storsand. Official sources document shore meadows, brickworks/clay-pit remains and a visitor nature/culture trail on existing roads and paths, but SAT itself continues east toward Ingmarsö. Do not treat as part of the main 1 km section geometry or as a facility.
